# Command Line Interface for Knowledge Compiler

The kc CLI provides a user-friendly interface for managing various tasks related to knowledge compilation. Users can initialize repositories, compile code, reconcile changes, verify builds, inspect repository status, and serve a read-only interface, which enhances workflow within software development and knowledge management.
